jobs.occupation: Account Manager (English and Spanish speaking) - Remote position
jobs.description:
This is a 100% remote position, i.e. you will work from home.
The company has developed a groundbreaking cloud service for transportation companies. They have customers all over the world.
They are experiencing strong demand of their product and because of that they need to strengthen their sales with a Spanish and English speaking salesperson.
We are looking for an outgoing and self-motivated Spanish and English speaking person who wants to work with sales towards North America from home.

About you 
Qualifications for this job
- A couple of years’ experience in B2B sales.
- Good track record in cold calling and outbound sales.
- Excellent customer assistance and problem solving skills.
- Fluent in English and Spanish with no accent.

We see it as a positive if you have previous experience in working with international SaaS sales.

About this position
You will be working with the North American market, which means that you will be working North American office hours, Monday to Friday.
You will be working with both assigned qualified leads and outbound sales, e.g. cold calling.
A lead is a transportation company who is looking to upgrade their booking system.
You will work with the full sales cycle from first demo to a closed deal. After the deal is closed you will continue working with the customers to make sure we keep them happy. 
The sales will mainly be done via web meetings and phone, so travelling will not be required for this position.
It is a very developing job in an international environment where you will interact with a lot of people every day.
Please, note that this position is 100% remote.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan Enskede is now seeking a qualified Spanish teacher for grades 6-9 to join our fantastic working environment in January 2027. This is your opportunity to work at our founding school in an international environment with a productive and encouraging team.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, positive, committed and cooperative team-player, willing to go the extra mile for students and colleagues. In addition to teaching meaningful and enjoyable lessons, all staff are expected to be well organised, take pride in their mentorship and other school duties and be outstanding role models for our students.

We require lärarlegitimation or if internationally qualified, a current teaching license/registration plus a Bachelor’s degree and teaching qualification.

Main duties include:

• Monitor progress and effectiveness of class work and evaluate and modify as necessary

• Provide a stimulating classroom environment for effective teaching and learning

• Maintain the positive ethos and core values of the school, both inside and outside the classroom

• Report to parents on the development, progress and attainment of students

• Maintain good order and discipline among students, in accordance with the school’s behaviour policies

• Mentorship of students is included in this position as well.

To apply, email your CV and cover letter to human.resources.enskede@engelska.se. Please, write "Spanish" in the subject of your email. 

Interviews will be held on an on-going basis. We recommend that you send in your application as soon as possible.

IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
We are currently seeking an enthusiastic MYP Teacher of Science and English Language Acquisition for a full-time temporary position of at least six months.

The role primarily involves teaching MYP students at the International School of Karlskrona, although some teaching within the PYP may also be included depending on the candidate's qualifications.

At ISK, you will teach within the Middle Years Programme and work according to IB educational methodologies. Teaching is conducted in English and is founded on inquiry-based learning, conceptual understanding, and an international perspective.

You are passionate about teaching and working with young people. You inspire students' curiosity and provide opportunities for them to grow both academically and personally. ISK has a strong collaborative culture, and you should enjoy working as part of a team and contributing to the school community as a whole.

KVALIFIKATIONER
We are looking for someone who:

· Is a certified teacher qualified to teach English, Science, or a comparable combination of subjects for Grades 7-9.

· Has completed IB teacher training and has previous IB experience.

· Can work according to the IB's inquiry-based and concept-driven educational philosophy.

· Can teach in English.

· Contributes to an international perspective in teaching.

· Can lead and organize learning effectively to create a calm and productive classroom environment.

· Builds trusting relationships with students and guides them in an inspiring manner.

· Works well collaboratively with colleagues and sees teamwork as a natural part of the profession.

· Has a good understanding of the school's governing documents and can apply them in daily practice.

Great importance will be placed on personal suitability. A background check is required prior to employment.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: 2026-11-20  Eller enligt överenskommelse, upphör: 2027-06-17  .
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

I Karlskrona kommun har du som medarbetare ett flertal förmåner. Några av de förmånerna är extra semesterdagar när du når en viss ålder, friskvårdsbidrag, möjligheten att gratis simma i någon av kommunens simhallar och ett riktigt bra tjänstepensionsavtal.

jobs.occupation: Operatör till valsverkstan/ Operator to Rolling Mill workshop
jobs.description:
SMS group är världsledande när det gäller framtidsinriktade teknologier och enastående service för metallindustrin. År 2024 genererade vårt team på över 13 500 anställda världen över en omsättning på mer än 4 miljarder euro. Vi tillämpar våra 150 års erfarenhet och vår digitala expertis för att kontinuerligt tillhandahålla branschen innovativa produkter och processer som sträcker sig bortom vår kärnverksamhet. Vi är den rätta partnern för utmanande projekt och stödjer våra kunder genom hela livscykeln för deras anläggningar och utrustning. Att bana vägen för en koldioxidneutral och hållbar metallindustri är vårt uttalade mål.
Om rollen / About the role
Svenska:
Som operatör i våra valsverkstäder kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i att säkerställa driften och effektiviteten av vår specialiserade utrustning samt leverera service och underhåll på kundens komponenter till de olika valsverken. Du kommer att arbeta med en rad olika teknikområden, vilket ger dig möjlighet att använda och utveckla din kompetens inom bland annat maskinbearbetning, montage, kvalitetskontroller och mätteknik.
English:
As an operator in our rolling mills, you will play a key role in ensuring the operation and efficiency of our specialized equipment and delivering service and maintenance on customer components to the various rolling mills. You will work with a range of different technical areas, giving you the opportunity to use and develop your skills in areas such as machining, assembly, quality control and measurement technology.
Din profil / Your profile
Svenska:
Arbetet innehåller både planerade och akuta service/underhållsåtgärder, vilket passar dig som tycker om att lösa problem och har en ”can do” inställning. Detta innebär även att du har ett öga för detaljer och en vilja att ständigt förbättra våra arbetssätt och processer. Det är viktigt att du trivs med att både arbeta självständigt och som en del av ett lag.
Du kan uttrycka dig väl i svenska och eller engelska då arbetet till stor del sker i samarbete med dina kollegor.
Vi ser gärna att du har en bakgrund inom maskinbearbetning, gärna inom tung industri, samt innehar en gymnasieexamen eller likvärdig utbildning.
Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av:
Arbete i en valsverkstad
Maskinbearbetning
Kvalitetskontroller och tillhörande mätinstrument
Hantering av travers/kran i verkstadsmiljö

English:
The work includes both planned and urgent service/maintenance measures, which suits you who like to solve problems and have a "can do" attitude. This also means that you have an eye for detail and a desire to constantly improve our working methods and processes. It is important that you enjoy working both independently and as part of a team.
You can express yourself well in Swedish and/or English as the work is largely done in collaboration with your colleagues.
We would like you to have a background in machining, preferably in heavy industry, and hold a high school diploma or equivalent education.
Experience in:
Working in a rolling mill
Machining
Quality controls and associated measuring instruments
Handling of overhead cranes/cranes in a workshop environment is an advantage

Om SMS group/Abour SMS group
Svenska:
Med SMS group hittar du internationella karriärmöjligheter. Våra värderingar ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE och SUCCEED har alltid varit en integrerad del av vårt arbete och är vad vi lovar våra kunder och anställda nu och i framtiden.
Låter detta som en intressant möjlighet? Välkommen till en arbetsplats där din utveckling är central och där vi tillsammans skapar morgondagens lösningar. Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan! Då rekryterings teamet är internationellt önskar vi din ansökan på engelska.
English:
With SMS group you will find international career opportunities. Our values ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE and SUCCEED have always been an integral part of our work and are what we promise our customers and employees now and in the future.
Does this sound like an interesting opportunity? Welcome to a workplace where your development is central and where we together create tomorrow’s solutions. We look forward to receiving your application in English!
Är detta för dig? / Is this for you?
Svenska
Låter det här som en intressant möjlighet? Ta chansen och skicka in din ansökan, CV och ett personligt brev på engelska.
Har du frågor om tjänsten är du självklart välkommen att kontakta oss. Notera att urval kommer att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, den 31 december 2026.
Vi ser fram mot din ansökan!
English
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? If so, we encourage you to apply by submitting your CV and cover letter in English. If you have any questions about the position, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Please note that applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline of 31 December 2026.
We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
Qualified Mathematics Teacher Years 4-6

IES Österåker opened in August 2024 and is a modern F-9 school with high ambitions. When fully established, the school will have around 600 students across two classes per year group.

We follow the Swedish national curriculum, with up to 50% of lessons taught in English. Our school is built on clear routines, high expectations, and a safe learning environment where students and staff can succeed.

The school is located in central Åkersberga, about 30 minutes from Stockholm. Our campus combines newly built and renovated facilities and is close to sports facilities, nature, and the Stockholm archipelago.

We are looking for an experienced and qualified Mathematics Teacher for Years 4-6 to join our team.

As a teacher, you will plan, teach, assess, and follow up on students' learning in mathematics. You will help students build confidence, develop problem-solving skills, and achieve strong academic results.

A key part of this role is meeting the needs of different learners. You should be able to support students who find mathematics challenging while also providing extension and enrichment for students who need greater academic challenge.

You will be a mentor for a group of students and work closely with parents, colleagues, the student support team, and school leadership to support student success.

We are looking for:

- Holds a valid teaching qualification and teaching license in Mathematics for Years 4-6.
- Is fluent in both Swedish and English.
- Can teach mathematics confidently in both Swedish and English.
- Has several years of successful teaching experience.
- Has a proven track record of helping students who struggle in mathematics make progress.
- Has experience supporting and challenging high-achieving mathematics students.
- Creates a calm, structured, and positive classroom environment.
- Has high expectations for all students.
- Works well with colleagues and enjoys being part of a team.
- Gives clear feedback that helps students improveWhat we offer: 

- A school with clear routines and strong leadership.
- Supportive and dedicated colleagues.
- An international working environment.
- The opportunity to help build and develop a growing school.
- A culture focused on learning, respect, and academic success.

The position is 100%. A six-month probationary period applies.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

A criminal background check is required before employment.

Welcome to ISSR
Are you an experienced and internationally minded English as an additional language teacher who is looking for an opportunity to be a part of the International School of the Stockholm region (ISSR) professional team? ISSR is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) school which offers four IB programmes. The school is a Stockholms stad school and was founded to primarily serve the educational needs of the transient community of Stockholm. ISSR has around 700 students, spanning from 6–19-year-olds and as such provide a coherent education across the IB continuum.
ISSR is built on an atmosphere where intellectual growth, personal reflection and international mindedness are the core concerns. Our primary goal is to prepare our students for higher education as we also prepare them for life.
Our students are inspired to take intellectual risks through the academically rigorous International Baccalaureate programmes – a pathway to top universities worldwide – nurturing creative critical thinkers empowered to help make our world a better place.
Read more about our school: https://internationalschoolofthestockholmregion.stockholm
Your Role
As an English as an Additional language teacher at ISSR, your position includes teaching English as an Additional language to students in grades 1-8, with most of the teaching taking place in the Primary Years Programme (grades 1-5). This position requires flexibility and strong collaboration skills. You are an active member of the PYP team and the language acquisition subject group. All teaching, learning and assessment is based on the International Baccalaureate (IB) Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) curricula. The position is temporary January 11 – June 18, 2027 and it is a full-time position.
Other responsibilities are:
Map the EAL needs
Teach EAL students according to student needs
Provide support to all EAL students in mainstream classrooms through push-in and pull-out sessions
Monitor and document the progress of EAL students
Support teachers in providing the best possible learning environment and experiences for EAL students
Collaborate with parents on how to support EAL learning
Plan and collaborate with colleagues across the school
Participate in school activities (assemblies, evening events, conferences, etc.)
On-going professional development 

Your competence and experience
A successful candidate is certified for and has experience to teach English as an additional language within the IB framework. You have a strong understanding and application of inquiry and concept-based teaching. We are looking for a teacher who has high expectations of the students and brings out the best in every student.
As an applicant, you must:
be a certified English as an additional language teacher for primary and/or secondary school students
have a professional level of written and spoken English

Other qualifications might also include
documented PYP/MYP IB working experience/ training
experience working as an English teacher in a school setting.

 
You have a strong ability to design teaching, learning and assessment in accordance with IB curriculum. You take responsibility for and have insight into the students' needs, and structure and adapt your teaching so that a safe and learning environment is created.  You are calm, have self-awareness and are a confident leader in the classroom. You value and create a productive working environment for your students. You put strong emphasis on collaboration and foster good relationships with students, parents and colleagues. You plan, organize, prioritize and analyze your lesson planning as well as other assignments that are part of your role in an efficient way.
We place major emphasis on personal competence and suitability for the role.
Miscellaneous
ISSR is strongly committed to professional development with a focus on IB workshops and trainings. As an employee in Stockholms stad you get a yearly health stipend.
Visit https://pedagog.stockholm/ for more information about what it is like to be a teacher in Stockholms stad.
The City of Stockholm works with competence-based recruitment that aims to ensure each person's competence and thus counteract discrimination.

jobs.description:
About this vacancy

Internationella Engelska Skolan Staffanstorp is now seeking a qualified teacher for grade 4-6 to join our fantastic working environment full time in January 2027. Teaching subjects are Maths and Science. This is your opportunity to work in an international environment with a productive and encouraging team.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, positive, committed and cooperative team-player, willing to go the extra mile for students and colleagues. In addition to teaching meaningful and enjoyable lessons, all staff are expected to be well organised, take pride in their mentorship and other school duties and be outstanding role models for our students.

We require lärarlegitimation or if internationally qualified, a current teaching license/registration plus a Bachelor’s degree and teaching qualification.

Main duties include:

• Monitor progress and effectiveness of class work and evaluate and modify as necessary

• Provide a stimulating classroom environment for effective teaching and learning

• Maintain the positive ethos and core values of the school, both inside and outside the classroom

• Report to parents on the development, progress and attainment of students

• Maintain good order and discipline among students, in accordance with the school’s behaviour policies

• Mentorship of students is included in this position as well.

Interviews will be held on an on-going basis. We recommend that you send in your application as soon as possible.

About IES

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group ("friskola") with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is through both Swedish and English, with English the language of the corridors. IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at "Grundskolan" . IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

More about the company and its schools can be found at www.engelska.se

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

Svenska
Som underhållsmekaniker kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i att säkerställa driften och effektiviteten av vår specialiserade utrustning. Du kommer att arbeta med en rad olika teknikområden, vilket ger dig möjlighet att använda och utveckla din kompetens inom bland annat mekanisk bearbetning, montage, hydraulik, kvalitetskontroller och mätteknik.
Vår verksamhet kommer att ha skiftgång varpå det är viktigt att du kan tänka dig att jobba skift.
English
As a Maintenance Mechanic you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our specialised equipment. You will work across a range of technical areas, with opportunities to apply and develop your skills in areas such as machining, assembly, hydraulics, quality inspections and metrology.
Our operations will run on a shift basis, so you must be willing to work shifts.
Om rollen / About the role
Svenska
Arbetet innehåller både förebyggande och akuta underhållsåtgärder, vilket passar dig som tycker om att lösa problem och har en ”can do” inställning. Detta innebär även att du har ett öga för detaljer och en vilja att ständigt förbättra våra arbetssätt och processer. Det är viktigt att du trivs med att både arbeta självständigt och som en del av ett lag.  
Du kan uttrycka dig väl i svenska och eller engelska då arbetet till stor del sker i samarbete med dina kollegor. 
English
The role involves both preventive and reactive maintenance, making it well suited to someone who enjoys solving problems and has a can-do attitude. You are detail-oriented and motivated to continuously improve our ways of working and processes. You should be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
As the role involves close collaboration with colleagues, you must be able to communicate effectively in Swedish and/or English.
Din profil / Your profile
Svenska
Vi ser gärna att du har en bakgrund inom mekaniskt underhåll, gärna inom tung industri, samt innehar en gymnasieexamen eller likvärdig utbildning. 
Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av: 
arbete i en valsverkstad eller en kokill- och segmentverkstad. 
lagerunderhåll och/eller tribologi. 
kvalitetskontroller och tillhörande mätinstrument. 

Personliga egenskaper som vi värdesätter inkluderar noggrannhet, problemlösningsförmåga och en stark ansvarskänsla. Du bör också ha förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i team, samt vara flexibel och anpassningsbar till förändringar i arbetsmiljön. Du är bekväm med att uttrycka dig på svenska och/eller engelska och förstår vikten av säkerhetsföreskrifter för att skapa en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö. 
Du är en person som tar initiativ och bidrar aktivt till att förbättra och effektivisera våra arbetssätt och processer. 
English
We would like you to have a background in mechanical maintenance, preferably in heavy industry, as well as an upper-secondary school diploma or equivalent qualification.
The following experience would be an advantage:
Working in a rolling mill workshop or a mould and segment workshop
Bearing maintenance and/or tribology
Quality inspections and the use of related measuring equipment

We value personal qualities such as attention to detail, problem-solving skills and a strong sense of responsibility. You should be able to work both independently and as part of a team, and be flexible and adaptable to changes in the work environment. You should be comfortable communicating in Swedish and/or English and understand the importance of following safety procedures to maintain a safe and secure workplace.
You take initiative and actively contribute to improving and streamlining our ways of working and processes.
Om SMS group/Abour SMS group
Svenska
Vi använder vår 150-åriga erfarenhet och digitala expertis för att kontinuerligt förse industrin med innovativa produkter och processer. Vårt mål är att bana väg för en koldioxidneutral och hållbar metallindustri. SMS group är en ledande partner för utmanande industriprojekt och vi stöttar våra kunder under hela livscykeln för deras anläggningar. Hos oss får du internationella karriärmöjligheter. Som ett globalt företag sysselsätter vi mer än 14 400 personer på över 100 platser. Våra värderingar ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE och SUCCEED har alltid varit en integrerad del av vårt arbete och är även vad vi lovar våra kunder och medarbetare idag och i framtiden.
Vi håller nu på och etablera oss i Boden och letar efter drivna medarbetare som delar våra värderingar och lockas av att vara med och forma vår verksamhet. Tillsammans bygger vi upp ett starkt team och vi erbjuder stora utvecklings- och karriärmöjligheter för dig som har ambition och vilja.
English
We draw on 150 years of experience and digital expertise to continuously provide industry with innovative products and processes. Our goal is to pave the way for a carbon-neutral and sustainable metals industry.
SMS group is a leading partner for challenging industrial projects, supporting our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their plants. We offer international career opportunities. As a global company, we employ more than 14,400 people across over 100 locations.
Our values—ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE and SUCCEED—have always been an integral part of how we work. They also represent our commitment to our customers and employees, today and in the future.
We are currently establishing our operations in Boden and are looking for driven people who share our values and are excited about helping shape our business. Together, we are building a strong team and offer excellent opportunities for development and career progression to those with the ambition and drive to succeed.
Är detta för dig? / Is this for you?
Svenska
Låter det här som en intressant möjlighet? Ta chansen och skicka in din ansökan, CV och ett personligt brev på engelska. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du självklart välkommen att kontakta oss.
Notera att urval kommer att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, den 31 december 2026.
Vi ser fram mot din ansökan!
English
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? If so, we encourage you to apply by submitting your CV and cover letter in English. If you have any questions about the position, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Please note that applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline of 31 December 2026.
We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Barnskötare till Svenska internationell förskolan i Hässelby
jobs.description:
Barnskötare – Hässelby
We are a cozy, welcoming preschool in Hässelby that follows the Swedish curriculum and with an international profile. We focus on language development and give children opportunities to grow as global citizens. Our preschool is bilingual, with Swedish and English as our working languages.
We are now looking for an experienced English speaking childminder (Barnskötare) who would like to be part of our continued development.
About the role
As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to grow and develop alongside the children, your colleagues and the organisation. You will take part in pedagogical planning and actively contribute to the daily activities. Together with the team, you will help create a safe, stimulating and creative environment for the children.
Requirements and desired qualifications
Experience: At least two years of experience working in a preschool.
Education: A recognised preschool assistant qualification (barnskötarutbildning) or equivalent.
Language skills: Highly proficient in English. Additional languages are an advantage.
Personal qualities: A positive attitude, a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to work well as part of a team.
Pedagogical responsibility: Willingness to take pedagogical responsibility and contribute ideas for the continued development of the preschool.
Knowledge of the curriculum: Good knowledge of the Swedish preschool curriculum (Lpfö) is an advantage.

Employment details
Working hours: 75-80%, with a start date to be agreed.
Probationary period: Six months, leading to a permanent contract.
Interviews: Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.
Police record check: A valid extract from the Swedish Police criminal records register is required for employment in a preschool.

How to apply
We warmly welcome your application via email and look forward to hearing from you soon!

Join our bilingual school where strong academic results, motivated students and a collaborative staff culture create an environment where both teachers and learners thrive.

Teaching is primarily conducted in English, while materials and documentation are in Swedish, requiring a structured and thoughtful approach to both subject content and language development.
Digital tools are an integrated part of our teaching and assessment practices, supporting differentiation and student progress.
About the role
Teach Technique in Years 4–9 in alignment with Lgr22.
Part-time position with a teaching load of approximately 9 hours of teaching per week
Plan and deliver structured, engaging lessons in a bilingual context
Collaborate with colleagues
Use digital tools to support assessment, feedback, and differentiation
Contribute to ongoing development of teaching and learning practices
We are looking for someone who:
Is confident working in a bilingual and international environment
Has a strong understanding of CLIL / språk- och kunskapsutvecklande arbetssätt
Is passionate about technique and striving towards high academic standards
Has experience differentiating instruction to meet diverse learner needs
Values collaboration and professional dialogue with colleagues
Is confident using digital tools to enhance student learning

We offer:
A supportive, collaborative team with a strong culture of shared practice
Opportunities to work in a bilingual and internationally-minded setting
Ongoing professional development and opportunities to grow within the role
Salary based on previous experience, qualifications, and demonstrated teaching expertise, in line with collective agreements
If you are a dedicated educator who values structure, collaboration, and high expectations-and who wants to contribute to a focused, inspiring and calm school environment-we would be pleased to hear from you.

IES Österåker opened in August 2024. We are a F-9 school, 2 parallel classes with up to 610 students. We are committed to our ethos which is a school with a calm and safe learning environment, bilingual teaching and high academic expectations.

IESÖ follows the Swedish national curriculum while embracing bilingualism and the command of the English language . After grade 3 up to 50% of the lessons are taught in English. 

The school is located in central Åkersberga, about 30 minutes from Stockholm and a 5 minute walk from Roslagsbanan. Our campus combines newly built and renovated facilities and is close to sports facilities, nature, and the Stockholm archipelago.

We are looking for a positive, creative, and service-minded person who will play an important role in creating a welcoming and engaging atmosphere at our school. You will have an integral role in key events and celebrations both from an organisational perspective as well as the practical. Many things that make IES Österåker special is that which is above and beyond the ordinary. 

It is important that you are comfortable with the creative and innovative side of things and that you interact well with children of all ages. You will assist students, parents, staff, and visitors, answer questions, manage day-to-day reception tasks, and help create a positive first impression of the school.

This includes welcoming and assisting visitors, ensuring no one enters the school without authorisation and vetting , helping maintain a safe and secure school environment, handling general office administration such as deliveries, managing incoming and outgoing post and supporting the practical organisation of the school among other things.We are looking for someone who:

- Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Is confident, welcoming, and professional when interacting with students, parents, staff, and visitors.
- Enjoys working in a busy school environment where no two days are exactly the same.
- Is highly organised and able to coordinate several tasks and events at the same time.
- Is creative and enjoys coming up with ideas for events, activities, and communication.
- Has an interest in social media, photography, content creation, or digital communication.
- Is flexible, solution-oriented, and happy to help wherever needed.
- Has excellent English and Swedish communication skills, both written and spoken.
- Swedish drivers licence is a plus What we offer

- A varied and creative role at a growing international school.
- A role where your ideas and initiative can make a real difference.
- A dynamic working environment where you will meet students, staff, parents, and visitors every day.
- Supportive and dedicated colleagues.
- The opportunity to help build and develop a growing school.
- A culture focused on learning, respect, community, and academic success.

The position is 100%

We apply a 6-month probationary period. 

Interviews will be conducted continuously during the application period, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

Would you like to work with a product loved by millions and millions of kids all across the world? With over 60 million monthly active users engaging with our play ecosystem, we are looking for a Senior Copywriter to join our Creative Hub. Working alongside highly talented animators, designers, and creative leads, you will play a defining role in telling great stories that inform, entertain, and bring Toca Boca’s products to life with relatable narratives that truly connect with kids and families globally.

You will be the guardian of our global Tone of Voice. You will balance visionary, high-level campaign ideation with hands-on creative execution, ensuring that Toca Boca sounds exactly like Toca Boca wherever we show up.

What you’ll be doing

Partner with Art Directors and Creative Leads to drive creative concepts and storytelling from the first brief all the way to final launch.

Create narrative-led marketing content (trailers, promo videos, full 360° campaigns) with relatable copy that truly connects with our core tween audience.

Balance high-level visionary work with hands-on daily production (VO scripts, performance ads, social captions, and in-app copy).

Leverage knowledge of platform specs (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram) to adapt copy natively while ensuring English source text is flawlessly structured for localization.

Own, update, and protect the Toca Boca Tone of Voice, ensuring everything we publish globally sounds exactly like us.

Partner with Product and Marketing to shape our stories, review creative output, and support the wider team in writing their own copy.

Identify opportunities to use emerging tools and technology to improve creative workflows.

Is This You?

You have 5+ years of experience working as a Copywriter, preferably with experience stepping into Creative Lead or conceptual roles. You thrive on balancing high-level visionary campaign strategy with hands-on, daily operational execution.

You hold a Bachelor's degree or similar in Copywriting, Communications, English, Creative Writing, or a related field, or you have equivalent professional experience.

You are a native English speaker with flawless grammar, sharp editing skills, and structurally precise writing.

You have experience developing, maintaining, and guarding a brand's Tone of Voice across multiple touchpoints.

You have a deep understanding of current social media trends, community engagement, and digital-first campaign storytelling. Prior experience in digital gaming, entertainment, or youth-focused tech is a major plus!

What we’ll be looking for in your portfolio

360° campaigns where you drove both the high-level concept and the final narrative arc.

Emotionally resonant work targeting tweens that feels authentic.

Examples proving you can define, adapt, and guard a distinct brand voice across digital, social, and physical touchpoints.

A strong mix of visionary thinking and sharp daily execution (social media content).

Flawless native English writing with the precision required for a sensitive audience.

Impactful copy built on universal truths rather than local slang, proving it can be translated globally without losing its core DNA. (Bonus)

This is us!

Toca Boca together with Sago Mini, Piknik and Lylli, make up Digital Games within Spin Master. We create games, digital toys, and everyday products that are filled with fun that kids from any corner of the world can instantly relate to. We celebrate the diversity and quirkiness of their world and give them the freedom to play in ways that only they can.

The Spin Master Mission and Vision is to make life more fun by pushing the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun!

Good to know!

This position is full time and based in our Stockholm office with a hybrid working model. We apply a 6-month probationary period. As we’re an international company, with over 20 nationalities working here, and millions of users all over the world, you must be fluent in English.

Toca Boca develops digital games that capture the power of play and that are filled with fun and silliness that kids around the world can instantly relate to. Since our first product launch in 2011, we have released 46 apps that have been downloaded more than 444 million times the world over, making us the No. 1 mobile-first kids brand in the App Store. Our products focus on sparking kids’ creativity and imagination, creating opportunities for open-ended play.

With offices in Stockholm and San Francisco, Toca Boca is owned by Spin Master Corp., a global children’s entertainment company that creates, designs and manufactures a diversified portfolio of innovative toys, games, products and entertainment properties.
